title: Nonreturn free translates vanish on the distinguished sheet
statement: Let \(k_0\subset k_1\) be finite fields, \(r\in\mathbf N\) satisfy \(\#k_1=(\#k_0)^r\), and let \(X/k_0\) and \(C/k_1\) be schemes. Write \(\bar X=X\times_{k_0}\bar k_0\), \(\bar C=C\times_{k_1}\bar k_1\), with scheme projections \(p_X,p_C\) and closure projections \(b_X,b_C\). Let \(\tau:\bar k_1\simeq_{k_0}\bar k_0\) be the chosen algebraic-closure isomorphism `algebraicClosureAlgEquiv k₀ k₁`, \(c:C\to X\) a monomorphism, and \(v:\bar C\to\bar X\) a map satisfying \(p_X\circ v=c\circ p_C\) and \(b_X\circ v=\operatorname{Spec}(\tau^{-1})\circ b_C\). Assume further that \(v\) is an open immersion, and fix a prime \(l\). For every pro-etale adic sheaf \(M\) on \(\bar C\) and \(n\in\mathbf Z\) with \(r\nmid n\), \(v^*\operatorname{Free.obj}(F,v_!M,n)\) is a zero object, where \(F=(\operatorname{Fr}_X^{-1})_*\) and Free.obj is the integer family of free-algebra summands used in [def-zl-frobenius-saturation]. There is no ambient Weil sheaf or map into one in this assertion.

proof.text: Identify each positive free summand with pushforward along the inverse of the corresponding Frobenius power, by induction using pushforward composition and identity isomorphisms. For negative summands, first identify the chosen quasi-inverse functor with pushforward along Frobenius, then apply the same induction.

proof.text: Convert pushforward along an inverse isomorphism to inverse image. Pullback composition identifies restriction of the summand with inverse image of extension by zero along the translated immersion. The existing disjoint-range vanishing theorem makes that object zero. Specifically apply ProEtale.isZero_adicUpperStar_adicOpenImmersionLowerShriek after adicUpperStarIsoLowerStarInv and adicUpperStarComp. This invokes [lem-sf-native-adic-open-restrictions].

lean.statement:
theorem isZero_clopen_nonreturn_freeObj
    {k₀ k₁ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] [Field k₁] [Finite k₁]
    [Algebra k₀ k₁] {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime]
    {X C : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k₀))] [C.Over (Spec (.of k₁))]
    (c : C ⟶ X) [Mono c]
    (r : ℕ) (hr : Nat.card k₁ = Nat.card k₀ ^ r)
    (v : (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiber ⟶ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
    [IsOpenImmersion v]
    (hp : v ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiberProj =
      (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiberProj ≫ c)
    (hb : v ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiberToAlgebraicClosure =
      (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiberToAlgebraicClosure ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraicClosureAlgEquiv k₀ k₁).symm.toRingHom))
    (M : ProEtale.AdicSheaf l (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiber)
    (n : ℤ) (hn : ¬ (r : ℤ) ∣ n) :
    IsZero ((v)^*ᵃ[l].obj
      (IsoAlgebra.Free.obj (frobeniusPullback k₀ l X) ((v)_!ᵃ[l].obj M) n))
